editorialDecl.p: Diplomatic transcription of printed pages 616–653. The page image is authoritative; OCR is corrected against it. Greek verse is encoded as numbered TEI lines. Printed orthography and editorial matter are preserved; machine-generated encoding requires review.

revisionDesc.change: Initial page-level extraction using deepseek-flash; prompt dindorf-sophocles-fragments-hathi-tei-v3-2026-10-08.
Recorded 701 conservative Dindorf correspondences to Nauck or Pearson from normalized quoted-Greek similarity; unmatched fragments remain unlinked.
Split the aggregate fragment corpus into the play-level CTS work tlg0011.ixion; wording was not changed.

div.quote: Παρὰ τὸ ἴψαι Σοφοκλῆς ἐν Ἰξίονι δίψιον φησὶ τὸ βεβλαμμένον. καὶ ῞Ομηρος “Πολυδίψιον ῎Αργος ἱκοίμην” πολλάκις βεβλαμμένον.
